summary: L-4 tower built on Pete Forks in 1934 in the Clearwater National Forest and destroyed in 1948; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1948; no source describes remains

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts classes the site as drive-up; no source describes the site today or whether visitors may go there

events.note: Destroyed; the sources give no cause

evidence.supports: Destroyed 1948 in the Forest Service list
Listed by name in the Forest Service list
List drawn from Kresek's book and Forest Service records
evidence.quote: From Ray Kresek’s book, Fire Lookouts of the Northwest, Forest Service records

evidence.supports: Marked as gone in the regional register

corrections.why: The firelookout.com listing reads Idaho County, Idaho; the record gives only the state name.

notes_for_editor: The three sources agree on the 1934 build and 1948 destruction. No staffing, fire or cause-of-loss information was found, and Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history, so nothing is written on those. The brief's county value 'Idaho' is corrected to Idaho County. Idaho Fire Lookouts says drive-up, but no source states whether the site is open to the public, so no access level is recorded. The regional register also lists 'Idaho' as the county.
